name: Feline-Project
description: Domain-adaptive NLP pipeline for feline veterinary NER using BERT

paragraphs: Note: This project was developed for educational and research purposes only and is not intended for medical or clinical use.

This project builds a specialized named entity recognition (NER) system for feline veterinary scientific literature. Starting from 11,830 PubMed Central articles, we performed domain-adaptive pre-training on BioBERT v1.2 to create Feline-BERT, a foundation encoder optimized for feline medical text. Using this encoder, we then trained Feline-NER, a token classification model fine-tuned on a manually annotated dataset of 1,300 sentences. The model extracts five clinical entity types (DISEASE, SYMPTOM, MEDICATION, PROCEDURE, ANATOMY) and achieves 64% Micro-F1 and 65% Macro-F1 on held-out test…
